context.content_translation:
工作人员不知道谁把手机留在了会议室。
A. neither
B. whose
C. nobody
D. whoever

items.question: The staff does not know - mobile phone was left behind in the conference room.
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：将“whose”代入题干后为“The staff does not know - mobile phone was left behind in the conference room. [whose]”。选择理由：该项同时满足句法结构、固定搭配和句意要求，其余选项至少有一项不符。正确答案：B（whose）。
